Verified: r42 (10:00) enabled smaller cache + retry policy. Errors rose 120→810, cache hits 92%→51%, retries 110→2200 at 10:03. Dependency CPU hit 96%. Rollback (10:06) restored metrics.

Hypothesis: Cache thrashing (92%→51%) caused cache misses, triggering retries (110→2200) that saturated dependency CPU (96%).

Validation: Replay r42 with controlled burst. Measure: if cache hit rate <70%, retry count >10x baseline, and dependency CPU >90%, hypothesis confirmed.
